title: Slim
description: Slim is a lightweight Fabric client mod featuring SwingSpeed, CustomFOV, and SpotiPlay — a built-in Spotify media player that displays on your HUD.
body:
# Slim

Slim is a lightweight Fabric client-side mod that adds three quality-of-life features to enhance your Minecraft experience.

## Features

### 🗡️ SwingSpeed
Customize your hand swing animation speed. Make it faster for a snappier feel or slower for a more relaxed look. Fully adjustable with a slider in the config screen.

### 🎯 CustomFOV
Set a fixed Field of View that stays consistent regardless of sprinting, potions, or other game effects. Simple slider to dial in your perfect FOV.

### 🎵 SpotiPlay
A Spotify HUD overlay that displays directly on your screen while you play. Shows:
- Current track name and artist
- Album art
- Progress bar with timestamps
- Playback controls (click to play/pause)

## How to Use
Open **Mods** on the main menu → find **Slim** → click the ⚙️ settings icon to configure each feature.

## Requirements
- Fabric Loader
- Fabric API
- Mod Menu
- Spotify (running in the background for SpotiPlay)
